40022927.author: पदार्थः
40022927.content: तस्यां in that, रजन्यां night, व्युष्टायां having dawned, यज्ञवाटगतो having gone to the sacrificial enclosure, नृपः the king, ऋषीन् the sages, सर्वान् all, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, शब्दापयति summons, राघवः Rama.

40022927.author: Translation
40022927.content: When that night had dawned, King Rama, the greatly effulgent one, having gone to the sacrificial enclosure, summoned all the sages.

40022928.author: पदार्थः
40022928.content: वसिष्ठो Vasistha, वामदेवश्च Vamadeva and, जाबालिरथ Jabali then, काश्यपः Kashyapa, विश्वामित्रो Vishwamitra, दीर्घतपा one of long penance, दुर्वासाश्च Durvasa and, महातपाः one of great penance

40022928.author: Translation
40022928.content: Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, Vishwamitra of great austerity, and Durvasa of great penance were present.

40022929.author: पदार्थः
40022929.content: पुलस्त्यो Pulastya, अपि also, तथा similarly, शक्तिः Shakti, भार्गवश्चैव Bhargava and indeed, वामनः Vamana, मार्कण्डेयश्च Markandeya and, दीर्घायुः long-lived, मौद्गल्यश्च Maudgalya and, महायशाः highly renowned

40022929.author: Translation
40022929.content: Pulastya, Shakti, Bhargava, Vamana, the long-lived Markandeya, and the highly renowned Maudgalya were also present.

40022930.author: पदार्थः
40022930.content: गर्गश्च Garga and, च्यवनश्चैव Chyavana and indeed, शतानन्दश्च Shatananda and, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, भरद्वाजश्च Bharadvaja and, तेजस्वी radiant, ह्यग्निपुत्रश्च and Agniputra and, सुप्रभः very luminous

40022930.author: Translation
40022930.content: Garga, Chyavana, Shatananda the knower of dharma, the radiant Bharadvaja, and the brilliant Agniputra were also among them.

40022931.author: पदार्थः
40022931.content: नारदः Narada, पर्वतश्चैव Parvata and indeed, गौतमश्च Gautama and, महायशाः highly renowned, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञश्च Suyajna and, ह्यगस्त्यः and Agastya, तपसां of austerities, निधिः a treasure

40022931.author: Translation
40022931.content: Narada, Parvata, the highly renowned Gautama, Katyayana, Suyajna, and Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, were also present.

40022932.author: पदार्थः
40022932.content: एते these, च and, अन्ये others, च and, बहवो many, मुनयः sages, संशितव्रताः of firm vows, कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः filled with curiosity, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled

40022932.author: Translation
40022932.content: These and many other sages of firm vows, all filled with curiosity, had assembled.

40022933.author: पदार्थः
40022933.content: राक्षसाः demons, च and, महावीर्या exceedingly valorous, वानराः monkeys, च and, महाबलाः exceedingly strong, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समाजग्मुः assembled, महात्मानः great-souled ones, कुतूहलात् out of curiosity.

40022933.author: Translation
40022933.content: All the great-souled demons of immense valor and monkeys of great strength assembled there out of curiosity.

40022934.author: पदार्थः
40022934.content: क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, ये who, च and, शूद्राः Shudras, च and, वैश्याः Vaishyas, च and, एव indeed, सहस्रशः by thousands, नानादेशगताः from various countries, च and, एव indeed, ब्राह्मणाः Brahmins, संशितव्रताः of firm vows.

40022934.author: Translation
40022934.content: Thousands of Kshatriyas, Shudras, and Vaishyas, along with Brahmins of firm vows from various countries, also gathered.

40022935.author: पदार्थः
40022935.content: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः devoted to knowledge, कर्मनिष्ठाः devoted to action, योगनिष्ठाः devoted to yoga, तथा and, अपरे others, सीताशपथवीक्षार्थम् for the purpose of witnessing Sita's oath, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled.

40022935.author: Translation
40022935.content: All these, including those devoted to knowledge, action, and yoga, had assembled there to witness Sita's oath.

40022936.author: पदार्थः
40022936.content: तदा then, समागतम् assembled, सर्वम् all, अश्मभूतम् like a stone, इव as if, अचलम् unmoving, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुनिवरः the best of sages, तूर्णं quickly, ससीतः with Sita, समुपागमत् approached.

40022936.author: Translation
40022936.content: Then, hearing that everyone had assembled and stood unmoving like a stone, the best of sages, Valmiki, quickly approached with Sita.

40022937.author: पदार्थः
40022937.content: तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, पृष्ठतः behind, सीता Sita, तु indeed, अन्वगच्छत् followed, अवाङ्मुखी with downcast face, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, बाष्पगला with a choked voice due to tears, कृत्वा having made, रामम् Rama, मनोगतम् present in her mind.

40022937.author: Translation
40022937.content: Sita, with a downcast face, folded hands, and a voice choked with tears, followed that sage from behind, having fixed Rama in her mind.

40022938.author: पदार्थः
40022938.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रुतिम् इव like a Veda, आयान्तीम् coming, ब्रह्माणम् Brahma (Valmiki), अनुगामिनीम् following, वाल्मीकेः Valmiki's, पृष्ठतः behind, सीताम् Sita, साधुवादः applause, महान् great, अभूत् arose.

40022938.author: Translation
40022938.content: Upon seeing Sita following Valmiki, appearing like a Veda following Brahma, a great acclamation of "excellent" arose from the crowd.

40022939.author: पदार्थः
40022939.content: ततः then, हलहलाशब्दः a tumultuous sound, सर्वेषाम् of all, एवम् thus, आबभौ appeared, दुःखजन्मविशालेन by the vast sorrow born of distress, शोकेन by sorrow, आकुलित agitated, आत्मनाम् whose minds were.

40022939.author: Translation
40022939.content: Then, a tumultuous clamor arose from all those whose minds were agitated by the vast sorrow born of their distress.

40022940.author: पदार्थः
40022940.content: साधु राम इति "Excellent, Rama!" thus, केचित् तु some indeed, साधु सीता इति च "Excellent, Sita!" thus and, अपरे others, उभौ एव च both indeed and, तत्र there, अन्ये others, प्रेक्षकाः spectators, सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः loudly acclaimed.

40022940.author: Translation
40022940.content: Some spectators acclaimed, "Excellent, Rama!", others cried, "Excellent, Sita!", and still others there loudly praised both of them.

40022941.author: पदार्थः
40022941.content: ततः then, मध्ये in the midst, जनौघस्य of the multitude of people, प्रविश्य having entered, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost of sages, सीतासहायः accompanied by Sita, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, इति thus, ह indeed, उवाच spoke, राघवम् to Rama.

40022941.author: Translation
40022941.content: Then, having entered the midst of the multitude of people, Valmiki, the foremost of sages, accompanied by Sita, spoke thus to Rama.

40022942.author: पदार्थः
40022942.content: इयम् this, दाशरथे O son of Dasharatha, सीता Sita, सुव्रता of excellent vows, धर्मचारिणी practicing righteousness, अपवादैः by slanders, परित्यक्ता abandoned, मम my, आश्रम hermitage, समीपतः near.

40022942.author: Translation
40022942.content: O son of Dasharatha, this is Sita, virtuous and righteous, who was abandoned near my hermitage due to public slanders.

40022943.author: पदार्थः
40022943.content: लोकापवादभीतस्य of one fearful of public scandal, तव your, राम O Rama, महाव्रत O great vow-keeper, प्रत्ययम् proof, दास्यते will give, सीता Sita, तत् that, अनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.

40022943.author: Translation
40022943.content: O Rama, keeper of great vows, you who are fearful of public scandal, Sita will provide proof, and you ought to permit her to do so.

40022944.author: पदार्थः
40022944.content: इमौ these two, तु indeed, जानकीपुत्रावुभौ both sons of Janaki, च and, यमजातकौ born as twins, सुतौ sons, तव your, एव indeed, दुर्धर्षौ formidable, सत्यम् truth, एतत् this, ब्रवीमि I speak, ते to you.

40022944.author: Translation
40022944.content: These two formidable sons, born as twins to Janaki, are indeed your own sons, and I speak this truth to you.

40022945.author: पदार्थः
40022945.content: प्रचेतसः of Prachetas, अहम् I, दशमः tenth, पुत्रः son, राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, न not, स्मरामि I remember, अनृतम् untruth, वाक्यम् a word, इमौ these two, तु indeed, तव your, पुत्रकौ sons.

40022945.author: Translation
40022945.content: O delight of the Raghus, I am the tenth son of Prachetas, and I have never uttered a lie; these two are indeed your sons.

40022946.author: पदार्थः
40022946.content: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि many thousands of years, तपश्चर्या penance, मया by me, कृता performed, न not, उपाश्नीयाम् I would enjoy, फलम् the fruit, तस्याः of that, दुष्टा impure, इयम् this, यदि if, मैथिली Maithili.

40022946.author: Translation
40022946.content: If this Maithili were impure, I would not partake of the fruit of the penance that I have performed for many thousands of years.

40022947.author: पदार्थः
40022947.content: मनसा by mind, कर्मणा by action, वाचा by speech, भूतपूर्वम् ever before, न not, किल्बिषम् sin, तस्याः of that (sinlessness), फलम् the fruit, उपाश्नीयाम् I would enjoy, अपापा sinless, मैथिली Maithili, यदि if.

40022947.author: Translation
40022947.content: If Maithili is sinless, then may I enjoy the fruit of never having committed any sin by thought, word, or deed.

40022948.author: पदार्थः
40022948.content: अहं I, पञ्चसु among the five, भूतेषु elements, मनष्षष्ठेषु with mind as the sixth, राघव O Raghava, विचिन्त्य having considered, सीतां Sita, शुद्धेति as pure, जग्राह I accepted, वननिर्झरे in the forest stream.

40022948.author: Translation
40022948.content: O Raghava, I, who am present in the five elements and the mind as the sixth, accepted Sita as pure, having considered her in the forest stream.

40022949.author: पदार्थः
40022949.content: इयं This, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, अपापा sinless, पतिदेवता devoted to her husband as a deity, लोकापवादभीतस्य of one who fears public scandal, प्रत्ययं conviction, तव to you, दास्यति will give.

40022949.author: Translation
40022949.content: This Sita, who is of pure conduct, sinless, and devoted to her husband as a deity, will provide conviction to you, who feared public scandal.

40022950.author: पदार्थः
40022950.content: तस्मात् Therefore, इयं this, नरवरात्मज O son of the best among men, शुद्धभावा of pure nature, दिव्येन by divine, दृष्टिविषयेण by the range of sight, तदा then, प्रविष्टा entered, लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा by one whose mind was defiled by public scandal, या who, त्यक्ता was abandoned, त्वया by you, प्रियतमा the dearest, विदिता known, अपि even, शुद्धा pure.

40022950.author: Translation
40022950.content: Therefore, O son of the best among men, this Sita of pure nature, whom you, whose mind was defiled by public scandal, abandoned even though she was known to be pure and dearest to you, then entered the divine realm. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ।। 96 ।। Thus ends the ninety-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
